title: Constructing continuous acceptor fibrillar networks and achieving uniform phase separation via polymer-assisted morphology control for 20.3% efficiency additive-free organic solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01843A, Paper
Fengbo Sun, Jingnan Wu, Bo Cheng, Lixuan Kan, Feng Hua, Wei Sun, Hao Wang, Yumiao Huo, Sixuan Chen, Xinxin Xia, Xiaoyan Du, Feng Liu, Ergang Wang, Xia Guo, Yongfang Li, Maojie Zhang
A small fraction of polymer acceptor was introduced as both nucleating agent and epitaxial growth template to enable small-molecule acceptor to form a continuous fibrillar network, achieving 20.3% efficiency in additive-free organic solar cells.
